SELECT lr.*, aa.agent_name FROM learning_resource lr LEFT JOIN ai_agent aa ON lr.agent_id = aa.id WHERE lr.user_id = #{dto.userId} AND lr.deleted = 0
AND lr.resource_type = #{dto.type}
AND (lr.resource_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.keyword}, '%') OR lr.knowledge_point LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY lr.create_time DESC
